# Phillips

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v1 c15 P40](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0040), [v1 c15 P57](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0057)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolmaster (teacher)  <sub>[v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 c15 P56](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0056), [v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091), [v2 c4 P7](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0007)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Mr. Phillips  <sub>[v1 c15 P13](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0013), [v1 c15 P40](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0040)</sub>; Teddy Phillips  <sub>[v1 c18 P6](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0006)</sub>

## Personality

Mr. Phillips is a strict, sarcastic, and unyielding teacher who frequently resort to whipping and public humiliation for discipline. He suffers from spasmodic fits of reform but is otherwise lax with order and prone to neglecting his younger pupils to focus on older ones. He can be quite obstinate and is easily distracted by his personal interests.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P44](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0044), [v1 c15 P45](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0045), [v1 c15 P57](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0057), [v1 c15 P60](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0060), [v1 c15 P68](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0068), [v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091), [v1 c21 P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002), [v2 c4 P7](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0007)_

## History

Mr. Phillips served as the schoolmaster at the Avonlea school. During his tenure, he was known for maintaining poor discipline overall, frequently resorting to whippings, and neglecting the younger students to focus his energy on preparing the advanced scholars for Queen's. He openly paid court to one of his older pupils, Prissy Andrews, helping her with her lessons in the evenings and giving her gifts. When Anne Shirley joined the school, he publicly humiliated her by making her stand by the blackboard for displaying temper and later by forcing her to sit with Gilbert Blythe for arriving late. Following a school concert and the end of the term, his engagement in Avonlea concluded at the end of June. Upon his departure, he delivered an emotional farewell speech to the school.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 c15 P31](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0031), [v1 c15 P44](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0044), [v1 c15 P45](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0045), [v1 c15 P61](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0061), [v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091), [v1 c18 P15](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0015), [v1 c19 P39](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0039), [v1 c20 P1](../source/v01-c20.md#nw-v01-c20-p0001), [v1 c21 P0](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0000), [v1 c21 P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002), [v2 c4 P7](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0007)_
